name: illustrator-scientific-tools
description: Create, inspect, refine, preflight, and export editable scientific figures directly in Adobe Illustrator through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable scientific figures directly in Adobe Illustrator.
interface.longDescription: Controls stable Adobe Illustrator through a pinned local MCP server. It creates and edits vector geometry, text, layers, artboards, and linked images; enforces scientific-figure typography and layer rules; reviews staged exports; saves native AI files; and runs delivery preflight checks.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable scientific figure directly in Adobe Illustrator.
Rebuild this reference figure in Illustrator and run preflight.
Inspect and refine the open Illustrator scientific figure.
